name: Yamazaki Kazumi
source:
A person with a frank and refreshing personality, talks even with the gloomy protagonist freely.
Has strong interest in sex and became sex friends with the protagonist. Afterwards, she got caught within the distorted love of the protagonist.
Was married before but divorced due to her husband's violent nature.
Since then, she gets more frightened than usual regarding violence.
